boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations on Oxford’s campus-adjacent Uptown corridors, each with a documented reason to stop.

cards.title: Bagel & Deli — steamed bagel sandwiches
cards.subtitle: High Street corridor, Uptown Oxford
cards.notes: Walk west on High Street to 119 E. High and order a steamed bagel sandwich or sub; the shop identifies itself as less than a half-block from campus.
cards.short_summary: A High Street deli with steamed bagel sandwiches and subs.
cards.evidence_claim: Bagel & Deli is at 119 E. High Street, less than a half-block from Miami University, and serves steamed bagel sandwiches and subs.
cards.access_notes: Check the shop’s current ordering and hours page before going.

cards.title: Kofenya — specialty coffee and food
cards.subtitle: High Street corridor, Uptown Oxford
cards.notes: Use the 38 W. High stop for specialty coffee, tea, pastries, or a toast; the shop’s official page lists its Oxford address and menu focus.
cards.short_summary: A coffeehouse on West High Street with drinks and food.
cards.evidence_claim: Kofenya is located at 38 W. High St. in Oxford and serves specialty coffee with a curated food and drink menu.
cards.access_notes: Review the current menu and contact details on Kofenya’s site.

cards.title: DuBois Book Store — Miami-branded gear
cards.subtitle: High Street corridor, Uptown Oxford
cards.notes: Stop at 118 E. High when you need Miami-branded apparel, accessories, gifts, or home goods; Miami lists the store among its Oxford retail locations.
cards.short_summary: An Uptown retailer listed by Miami for branded merchandise.
cards.evidence_claim: Miami University lists DuBois Book Store at 118 E. High St. as an Oxford retailer for Miami-branded gear and apparel.
cards.access_notes: Store hours and special closures are posted by DuBois.

cards.title: Oxford Community Arts Center — arts programming
cards.subtitle: College Avenue corridor, Uptown Oxford
cards.notes: At 10 S. College Ave., check the arts center’s program calendar and building access before arrival; its mission includes fine and performing arts programming.
cards.short_summary: A community arts center in the historic Oxford College building.
cards.evidence_claim: The Oxford Community Arts Center at 10 S. College Ave. is an independent nonprofit fine and performing arts center with cultural and arts programming.
cards.source_title: Oxford Community Arts Center — Board of Trustees
cards.access_notes: Building hours and event availability vary; consult the center’s calendar.

cards.title: Art Shop — local artists’ work
cards.subtitle: College Avenue corridor, inside Oxford Community Arts Center
cards.notes: Enter the Oxford Community Arts Center at 10 S. College Ave. to browse the Art Shop’s locally made pottery, paintings, jewelry, and gifts.
cards.short_summary: A shop inside the arts center featuring locally made work.
cards.evidence_claim: The Art Shop at 10 S. College Ave., inside the Oxford Community Arts Center, carries one-of-a-kind arts and crafts made by local artists.
cards.access_notes: Visit during Oxford Community Arts Center building hours.

cards.title: College@Elm Innovation Center — innovation corridor
cards.subtitle: College Avenue and Elm Street corridor, Uptown Oxford
cards.notes: Pass the College and Elm intersection to see the named innovation-center project, part of a three-block effort described by Miami and the City of Oxford.
cards.short_summary: A named redevelopment project at the College–Elm intersection.
cards.evidence_claim: Miami University describes College@Elm as an initiative with the City of Oxford to transform a three-block area along College Avenue and Elm Street into an innovation corridor.
cards.source_title: Miami University — Miami and Oxford initiative to transform uptown into an entrepreneurial hub
cards.access_notes: This is an outdoor corridor stop; observe posted site-access restrictions.

cards.title: Oxford Doughnut Shoppe — kettle-fried doughnuts
cards.subtitle: South Locust Street corridor, Uptown Oxford
cards.notes: Head to 120 S. Locust for kettle-fried doughnuts and coffee; Travel Butler County lists the shop as an Oxford stop on its Donut Trail.
cards.short_summary: A South Locust doughnut shop included on the county’s Donut Trail.
cards.evidence_claim: Oxford Doughnut Shoppe at 120 S. Locust St. is a Butler County Donut Trail stop that makes old-fashioned kettle-fried doughnuts.
cards.source_title: Travel Butler County — Oxford Doughnut Shoppe
cards.access_notes: Hours and sellout conditions vary; verify before leaving.

cards.title: Oxford Lane Library — public library resources
cards.subtitle: South Locust Street corridor, Oxford
cards.notes: Use the library at 441 S. Locust for its public library services; check the location page for current open hours before planning a visit.
cards.short_summary: Oxford’s Lane Libraries branch on South Locust Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Lane Libraries lists Oxford Lane Library at 441 S. Locust St. in Oxford and publishes its location hours.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: Monday–Thursday 9 a.m.–8 p.m.; Friday–Saturday 9 a.m.–6 p.m.; Sunday 1–5 p.m.

cards.title: Smith Library of Regional History — regional-history collections
cards.subtitle: South Locust Street corridor, at 441 S. Locust
cards.notes: At 441 S. Locust, use the named regional-history library for a focused history stop; confirm its split-day hours or Saturday appointment requirement first.
cards.short_summary: A named regional-history library at the Oxford Lane Library address.
cards.evidence_claim: Lane Libraries lists the Smith Library of Regional History at 441 S. Locust St. and publishes dedicated hours for the location.
cards.access_notes: Published hours include Monday 10 a.m.–noon and 1–8 p.m.; Saturday is by appointment only.

cards.title: Oxford Farmers Market Uptown — year-round Saturday market
cards.subtitle: East Park Place / Main and High Street corridor, Uptown Oxford
cards.notes: On Saturday morning, find the market near Memorial Park at Main and High; its official site says vendors offer local and seasonal foods, goods, and artisan work.
cards.short_summary: A Saturday market beside Oxford’s Uptown parks.
cards.evidence_claim: Oxford Farmers Market Uptown operates year-round near Memorial Park at Main and High streets, with vendors selling local and seasonal foods and goods.
cards.access_notes: The market lists Saturday hours of 9 a.m.–noon; seasonal details may change.
